description: This file defines the LoginServices class, which provides various static methods for user login, impersonation, password management, and user account updates within the OFBiz framework. It handles authentication, password updates, login history, and security checks, serving as a core component for user login services.
external_methods: // Function used for Tomcat SSO login, assumed to be implemented elsewhere

classes.name: LoginServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for user login, impersonation, password management, and security updates within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: userLogin
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username and password or token, manages login history, external auth, and handles account status.

methods.name: userImpersonate
methods.description: Allows one user to impersonate another, updating login sessions and creating impersonation history entries.

methods.name: createUserLogin
methods.description: Creates a new user login record with validation and password history management.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a user login, with security checks and password history updates.

methods.name: updateUserLoginId
methods.description: Changes the user login ID for a user while preserving associated data and deactivating the old login.

methods.name: updateUserLoginSecurity
methods.description: Updates security-related info for a user login, such as enabled status and disable date.

methods.name: createUserLoginPasswordHistory
methods.description: Stores password change history for a user login, respecting configured limits.

methods.name: checkImpersonationControls
methods.description: Validates whether impersonation is allowed based on security policies and user roles.

methods.name: getHashType
methods.description: Retrieves the password hashing algorithm type from configuration, defaulting to SHA if unspecified.

methods.name: checkPassword
methods.description: Compares a stored password (hashed/encrypted) with a provided password for verification.

methods.name: checkNewPassword
methods.description: Validates new password against security policies, history, pattern, length, and username/hint restrictions.
